notes: This contract defines the portable C++ TCK boundary for timestamped attribute update-rate reduction. The case uses only official RTIambassador publication, active named/default subscription, update-rate query, timestamped update, time-advance, and retraction services plus the corresponding FederateAmbassador callbacks. FOM contents, logical-time implementation, endpoint, provider library, callback model, and declaration names are adapter inputs.

api_surfaces.signature: subscribeObjectClassAttributes(ObjectClassHandle const&, AttributeHandleSet const&, bool, std::wstring const&)
api_surfaces.standard_boundary: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador active subscription and update-rate designator overload

api_surfaces.signature: updateAttributeValues(..., LogicalTime const&) / reflectAttributeValues(..., LogicalTime const&, ...)
api_surfaces.standard_boundary: IEEE 1516.1 timestamped object update and reflection callback
